name: SuperAnnotate
tagline: Platform for building multimodal AI datasets and evaluation pipelines.
description: SuperAnnotate is an enterprise data platform for creating, managing, and evaluating high-quality datasets for AI. It spans annotation across images, video, text, audio, and LiDAR, with AI-assisted labeling, customizable workflows, and an optional managed annotation workforce. Teams use it to build human-in-the-loop data and evaluation pipelines for agentic, multimodal, and frontier AI.
insight: Its $50M Series B drew NVIDIA, Databricks, and Dell Technologies Capital; the company was founded in Armenia.

modelSupport.notes: Labeling, fine-tuning data, and model/LLM evaluation; not tied to one model.

edge: Spans the full data loop — multimodal annotation, an optional expert workforce, and model evaluation — in one enterprise platform.
pros: Multimodal: image, video, text, audio, LiDAR
cons: Enterprise focus is heavy for small teams
Costs scale with volume and workforce

references.title: SuperAnnotate snags $13M in funding to take on Scale AI and Surge AI
